title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ygp9: from_bytes_for bitmap uses 62-position but write_to uses 31-position
description: In `fragment.rs`, `from_bytes_for` reads bitmap bits with `bitmap |= 1u64 << (62 - position)` but `write_to` writes with `1u64 << (WINDOW_SIZE - 1 - position)` (= `31 - position`). Since `BITMAP_MASK = (1 << 32) - 1 = 0xFFFFFFFF`, bits at positions 62-32 are zeroed by `& BITMAP_MASK` in `new()`, causing the non-canonical check (`write_to` round-trip) to always fail for any ACK with bits set in positions 0-30. The `62 - position` should be `WINDOW_SIZE - 1 - position` (= `31 - position`) to match `write_to`. This is pre-existing; this commit only fixed W/C bit positions (bit 7/6) and complete ACK handling, which are correct.
